notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.10
notes.notes:
We are diligently preparing for the release and in this update we have added:

🏅 Steam Achievements
💬 Improved hints for interacting with some interactive objects
✨ Improved the interface
🛠️ Fixed some minor bugs

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.6
notes.notes:
The release is coming and we continue to work on improving the game. Here is a list of improvements in this update:

⚔️ Added the ability to destroy Dark Entities in the Abandoned Zone
💖 Added a new item "Nice Memories"
🔨 Added a new recipe for crafting in the workshop
✅ Added 1 more optional quest
🎻 Written 1 more soundtrack
🛠️ Many small fixes and improvements

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.5 - Pre-release update ✨
notes.notes:
We are working hard on the release, trying to make the gameplay as convenient as possible and here is the list of changes:

🗺️ A map for the central location has been added
💬 Added hints for items that can be used
🤩 Minor interface improvements
🔑 Added a small hint for completing one of the quests in the maze
🎮 Added more interactive objects

We can't wait to show the game! We hope everyone will find something of their own in it 💖

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
🤖 Added tunnels for quick return to the Abandoned Zone location from the maze
🛠️ Minor fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Added a button to open the game menu to the interface
 Fixed multiple subtraction of items from the inventory when using them
 Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Fixed re-adding of reward after completing the quest
 Reduced the number of required parts for the antenna to 150 (each part now needs to be collected 25 pieces)
 Added a hint on completing the quest in the Winter Room
 Fixed inventory/menu freezing after installing the Crystallizer at the factory
 Added a special soundtrack for level 13 of the labyrinth
 Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug when repairing a statue
 Fixed a repeating message when items are lost
